card.name: Fixed phrases and USP after drug names
card.fires_on: Fires on "of" in the book title "Reliance of the Traveller", on "US" in "USP" after a drug name and comma, and on middle digits of decimal concentrations.

modes.label: Book title
modes.description: The word "of" inside the title The Reliance of the Traveller.

modes.label: USP after drug name
modes.description: "US" of "USP" following a product name and comma.
modes.example: Imaging of Sodium Fluoride F 18 Injection,<< US>>P can begin 1-2 hours

modes.label: Digits in decimals
modes.description: Digits inside a decimal number in a dose or concentration table.
modes.example: 969 mcg 0.25 mg/mL 5.938 mcg 0.5 mg/mL 11.<<8>>75 mcg 1 mg/mL
